findings.title: Italian text inserted as the Lithuanian translation of totpStep1
findings.body: To remove the anchor tags, the Lithuanian `totpStep1` was replaced with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. That is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an untranslated Italian sentence in the account console. The old Lithuanian text should be reduced to a proper translation of 'Install one of the following applications on your mobile:' instead.

findings.title: Italian text inserted as the Lithuanian translation of loginTotpStep1
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` now reads `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. The Lithuanian login OTP setup page will show an Italian instruction instead of Lithuanian. The previous Lithuanian sentence was replaced with the wrong language.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text placed in the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) bundle
findings.body: `totpStep1` was replaced with `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`, which uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The same bundle and the zh_CN login bundle use Simplified Chinese (手机, 安装, 应用). This looks copied from zh_TW and gives zh_CN users the wrong script and wording.

findings.title: i18next placeholders replaced with Java MessageFormat syntax in a JS-consumed bundle
findings.body: Every other `error-*` key in this account-ui bundle uses i18next interpolation (`'{{0}}'`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`). `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed to MessageFormat style (`{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}`, `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`). i18next does not interpolate `{0}` and does not evaluate `choice` expressions, so the UI is likely to show the raw placeholders. The change is also unnecessary for adding the HTML verifier, because the verifier already tolerates `{{n}}`.

findings.title: admin-ui bundle: i18next `{{n}}` placeholders replaced by MessageFormat `{n}` and `choice`
findings.body: This file is consumed by the admin UI through i18next, and its other `error-*` messages use `{{0}}`-style interpolation. `error-invalid-multivalued-size` is changed to `Attribute {0} ... {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. i18next will not substitute `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` or evaluate the choice, so the validation error would display literal placeholders. This is a functional change unrelated to HTML sanitizing.

findings.title: Choice-format expressions are blanked out before sanitizing, so HTML inside them is never checked
findings.body: For keys starting with `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit` and for `error-invalid-multivalued-size`, `normalizeValue` replaces `\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}` with `...` before sanitizing. Any markup inside a choice branch (for example `{0,choice,0#|1#minute}`) is never seen by the sanitizer. The `linkExpirationFormatter` values are inserted into HTML email bodies, so the verifier silently passes a translation that can inject HTML. The exemption should be limited to the `<` in the choice operator, or the branches should be sanitized separately.

findings.title: Diff-context computation can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when the common prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body: `start` and `end` are computed independently and can overlap. If a translation has an unclosed tag at the very end, such as `text `, the sanitizer closes it as `text `. Then `start == value.length()` and `end == 1`, so `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)` is called with begin greater than end and throws. The build then fails with an unhelpful runtime exception instead of reporting 'Illegal HTML in key ...'. `end` should be capped at `min(len) - start`.

findings.title: Anchor-tag error message names neither the key nor the file
findings.body: `santizeAnchors` receives `key` but never uses it. It reports only `Didn't find anchor tag <a ...> in original string`. With hundreds of translation files checked per build, the maintainer cannot tell which file or key has the unexpected anchor. The 'Illegal HTML' message includes both, and this message should too.

findings.title: English reference file is derived by regex over the whole absolute path and failures surface as raw RuntimeException
findings.body: The English file path comes from `replaceAll` on the entire absolute path (`resources-community` anywhere, then the first `_xx.properties` suffix). If no `_en` counterpart exists at the derived location, an unchecked `RuntimeException` is thrown instead of a `MojoExecutionException` or a clear message. A single translation bundle without a sibling English file would then abort the whole verification with a stack trace.

findings.title: No positive test cases; duplicate-key assertion weakened
findings.body:
All new tests check only that an error is reported. There is no test where a translation legitimately contains the allowed HTML (``, `

`, `
`, an identical anchor, `{{0}}`, or choice formats) and the result must be empty, so false-positive regressions in the sanitizer comparison would go unnoticed. The duplicate-key test was also weakened from `contains` to `hasItem`, so it no longer fails if the verifier starts emitting unrelated messages for that file.
